beneficiary), marked as required or excluded. They are not shown to you.

- revise: After each scoring you receive the list of discrepancies for that dossier: documented positions your committed theory did not derive, and excluded positions it derived with the hypotheses responsible. You may propose, evaluate and commit again; changes apply to the following dossiers.

Your task: keep the loss low on the dossiers you have not seen yet.

Budgets for the whole trajectory: 8 verified evaluations, 12
proposals, 8 turns per phase. Every turn is exactly one tool call.

    & higherAuthority(highAuthority, lowAuthority) @ t
    & notEarlier(highDate, lowDate) @ t
    <= annulled(low, high, highAuthority, highDate) @ t

    & prohibition(low, subject, conduct, object, beneficiary, lowAuthority, lowDate) @ t
    & higherAuthority(highAuthority, lowAuthority) @ t
    & notEarlier(highDate, lowDate) @ t
